subject: Discovery recap + scheduling: Private/VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-05T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Private VPC architecture review

Hi Alice — thanks again for a great call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key takeaways from today's discovery:
- Acme Cloud is evaluating a private/VPC deployment for regulated customer workloads (PII in-scope).
- Primary concerns: network isolation, egress controls, KMS/HSM for key management, audit logs, and data residency.
- Expected initial footprint: 2-4 GPU nodes for pilot, growth to 8+ for production.
- Timeline: pilot in Q1, production targeted Q2 2029.

Next step: schedule a focused architecture review with our infra and security engineers (30-45m). Goals for the call:
- Review proposed VPC/network topology and egress pattern
- Validate KMS/HSM integration and key rotation workflow
- Confirm logging/audit requirements and retention
- Identify any procurement/network pre-reqs from your side

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed Nov 8 — 10:00-10:45am PST
- Thu Nov 9 — 11:00-11:45am PST

If those don't work, please propose a couple of slots and I can send a calendar invite. Could you also confirm who from your side should join (network, security, infra)?

Attached: discovery_notes.pdf (call notes + rough scope).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
https://redwood.ai

--
Attachment: discovery_notes.pdf (summary of today's discovery call)
